signature.name: Spirit bond
signature.description: Choose from 16 pets at the Aeven Eggkeeper or earn bound eggs from monsters. Five tiers multiply your equipped attack by 0.45/0.7/1.0/1.2/1.5. Pets retaliate when an aggressive monster hurts you; higher tiers spend more TP. One TP-funded living bond lasts until your death. Travel, logout and TP exhaustion keep it. Recover 0.4% max TP every 2 seconds; double sitting, half in PK. PK areas use stronger spirit casting instead of pets.

full_kit_audit.scope: 108 full-slot standard/damage/defence builds, levels 1/8/15/25/35/45, male body, 60/25/15 allocation, untrained spells. Coordinate ascent is an outlier search, not an exhaustive optimum. Common items, shields, two rings, two armlets and two bracers are included. Weight must fit. Sustained 60s uses full starting TP, standing recovery and pet call/upkeep; offensive casting and healing budgets are alternatives, not simultaneous. Damage/area calculations use reference armour/evasion; defence uses a level-appropriate installed encounter at one incoming attack per second. Movement, range, misses in player targeting and time reaching enemies are not simulated.

encounters.scope: Real native packet combat, regular level45 damage-optimized legal full kits, untrained spells, full starting HP/TP, default crit/hit formulas. No stat cheats. Supplied scenario gives each player the same five Big Health Potions; potion usage is recorded. Stationary NPC cannot attack; retaliating copy uses normal .9s NPC actions and no natural respawn. Automatic controller does not kite or circle behind a live opponent; Rogue rear ceiling and movement are separately verified, not assumed always available. Priest heals share action time with damage. Pet call precedes fight; starting TP records its cost; normal upkeep is active. This is a small randomized sample, not proof of equal skill or class win rate.
